record_title: Logarithmic provisioning clocks and finite consumption capacity in a resource-coupled mortality model
provenance: A source-specific asymptotic analysis of the resource-coupled crew-health ODE in arXiv:2609.20430v1. Positive spontaneous deterioration yields a logarithmic large-buffer threshold clock, while zero deterioration has finite lifetime consumption and an explicit high-buffer depletion constant.
limitations: The result concerns the deterministic ODE model and fixed positive provisioning thresholds. It does not assess historical calibration, stochastic events, heterogeneous crews, resupply, or the detailed intermediate-buffer crossover regime.
